answer: A fixed refundable bond must be escrowed before any agent identity can register, so a sybil operator pays that bond for every fake account out of one treasury and must fund thousands of slots at once. Rational grading further kills the herd: per-identity payout is capped below the bond, so reward collected across N identities stays less than N times the stake already locked, turning scale into guaranteed loss. New keys from one untrusted meadow cluster who try to enter the orchard sharing a common ripple of paymaster funding stand out cheaply, letting verifiers slash before value moves.
